vo: Does de minimis skip your certificate? Not if your product needs one.
Say customs holds them. My broker asks for the certificate data.
De minimis doesn't skip it. The data still gets eFiled at entry.
Imported by mail? The data goes into C P S C's Product Registry before arrival.
Blocked right now? Forward the notice. Get your gap list in twenty-four hours.
caps: Say I'm a seller. I ship small parcels.
My broker needs the certificate data.
Fact: de minimis isn't a certificate exemption.
Data into CPSC's Product Registry before arrival.

props.phoneMsg: “I need the certificate data to file the entry.”
